_comment: Per-adapter bench baselines. CI fails if a metric is >10% worse than the entry for its adapter. Dev-machine entries are the median of 3 local runs. GitHub runner entries end in " @ github-actions" (bench.rs adds it when GITHUB_ACTIONS=true), so a runner image can't pick up a dev machine's entry for the same llvmpipe version (LLVM 21.1.8 did on 2026-11-09). The LLVM 20.1.2 runner entry is the worst of 4 CI runs (2026-10-10), because shared runners vary 5-14% run to run; its decode_volume_ms was re-recorded on 2026-10-28 as the worst of 2 CI runs (170.7, 174.7 ms) after the runner slowed down (local decode unchanged, ~148 ms on main and on the PR). Record new adapters from a run's --bench-out (README).
